Verified OEM Replacement Part That Fixes This Code

Ulka EX5 / EP5 120V 60Hz 41W 15-Bar Espresso Vibratory Water Pump

Primary OEM Ref: ULKA-EX5-120V · Cross-Ref / Alternate: SP0020448 (Breville OEM Pump) / 5113211291 (DeLonghi 120V US Pump)

OEM #ULKA-EX5-120V
🛒 Check OEM Part #ULKA-EX5-120V on Amazon.com →

* Always match OEM Part ULKA-EX5-120V with your appliance model sticker before ordering.

⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The espresso machine heats up and the vibratory pump buzzes (either very quietly or with a hollow metallic clatter), but the pressure gauge stays flat and little or no water comes through the group head.

Verified technical root cause: The internal check-valve ball and spring inside the 15-bar Ulka electromagnetic vibratory water pump have worn out or air-locked from scale.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Open the steam/hot water wand valve with no portafilter attached: if hot water still refuses to pump out in a steady stream, the Ulka vibratory pump has lost prime or failed.
  2. Unplug the machine, remove the rear cabinet panel, move the two push-on electrical terminals and silicone hoses onto the new 120V Ulka EX5/EP5 pump, and run hot water for 15 seconds to prime it.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (No Water Flow / Low Pressure Gauge / Loud Buzzing)

Should I buy the 120V or 230V Ulka EP5/EX5 pump in the United States?
For US and Canadian 110–120V wall outlets, always select the 120V 60Hz 41W version of the Ulka EP5 or EX5 (brass outlet).
